function: Four 64 KiB windows. CPU A16-A17 (latched by IC17) select one of four 8-bit bank registers in IC61/IC62 (74HC670), which drive physical A16-A23. CPU A18 is not used, so the windows repeat at 0x40000-0x7FFFF
source: Akai S950 schematic diagrams, CPU PCB (1/2) No. 6-2 L601302M and (2/2) No. 6-3 L601303M; MAME s900.cpp at c2caa8969adb s950_state::mem_map and bank_w

function: 64 KiB word-wide ROM on CPU A1-A15, repeated every 64 KiB. IC17 latches CPU A19; that it selects the ROM is inferred, not traced
source: Akai S950 schematic diagrams, CPU PCB (1/2) No. 6-2 L601302M and (2/2) No. 6-3 L601303M; MAME s900.cpp at c2caa8969adb s950_state::mem_map

function: 24-bit address A1-A23 from the bank registers (A16-A23) and the CPU (A1-A15)
Physical A19-A21 decoded by IC89 (CD74AC138) into -CAS0 to -CAS7: eight 512 KiB banks
source: Akai S950 schematic diagrams, CPU PCB (1/2) No. 6-2 L601302M and (2/2) No. 6-3 L601303M, sheet 2/2

function: Four MB81C4256 (256K x 4): one full 16-bit bank, 512 KiB (D0-D15). Its CAS line was not traced
source: Akai S950 schematic diagrams, CPU PCB (1/2) No. 6-2 L601302M and (2/2) No. 6-3 L601303M, sheet 2/2

function: Three MB81C4256 on D4-D15 only: a 256K x 12-bit bank. Its CAS line was not traced
source: Akai S950 schematic diagrams, CPU PCB (1/2) No. 6-2 L601302M and (2/2) No. 6-3 L601303M, sheet 2/2

device: Expansion connectors J108 and J109 (EXM006 boards)
function: Carry AD3-AD15, RA0-RA8, A22, A23, RAS, MRD, LSW, MSW and CAS lines: J109 CAS0-2 and CAS4-7 (pin for CAS3 is NC); J108 CAS0-3, CAS6, CAS7 (CAS4 and CAS5 pins are NC)
source: Akai S950 schematic diagrams, CPU PCB (1/2) No. 6-2 L601302M and (2/2) No. 6-3 L601303M, sheet 2/2
